commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+3' Post! Milan Djuric (Monza) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
90+2' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Alessio Iovine (Como) for his blatant foul.
90+2' Como can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Nico Paz (Como) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
89' The free kick from long range, taken by Monza, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
88' It's time for a substitution. Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como) comes on in place of Gabriel Strefezza.
87' Como have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' The resulting set piece from Como is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Corner kick. Como will have an opportunity.
84' A free kick into the box, taken by Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marco Sala (Como) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Here comes a substitution. Mattia Valoti (Monza) is brought on as a substitute for Gianluca Caprari.
81' Alessandro Nesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) replacing Luca Caldirola.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marco Sala (Como) replaces Alberto Moreno.
80' Como failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
78' Simone Verdi (Como) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
77' Andrea Belotti (Como) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
74' Como take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Como comes to nothing. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Como.
73' Como take a short corner kick.
72' Alberto Moreno (Como) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Como.
69' The substitution has been made. Andrea Belotti (Como) has replaced Patrick Cutrone.
68' Substitution. Alieu Fadera will be replaced by Simone Verdi (Como).
68' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Ignace Van der Brempt and he is replaced by Alessio Iovine (Como).
68' Substitution. Samuele Birindelli (Monza) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pedro Pereira walks off.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monza.

66' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Monza will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
64' Patrick Cutrone (Como) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
63' Alieu Fadera (Como) commits a foul during an attacking move.
61' Warren Bondo (Monza) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Como.
58' Daniel Maldini (Monza) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
56' A pass into the box finds Patrick Cutrone (Como) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Stefano Turati denies him.
54' 1 - 1 Goal! Gianluca Caprari (Monza) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Pepe Reina into the bottom left corner.
53' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) is going to take the penalty!
53' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
51' There's a break in play and referee Juan Luca Sacchi must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Monza using VAR. This could be interesting!
50' Nico Paz (Como) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
50' Monza try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
49' Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Edoardo Goldaniga (Como). Monza are awarded the free kick.
48' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daniel Maldini (Monza) will replace Dany Mota.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Luca Sacchi starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+2' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
45+1' Wow, what an escape. Gabriel Strefezza (Como) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Good work from Como as they win a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monza, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
44' Nico Paz (Como) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
43' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
41' Pepe Reina comes off his line to intercept the corner from Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza).
40' Stefano Turati displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Patrick Cutrone (Como) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
36' 1 - 0 Yannik Engelhardt (Como) gets to the rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the right post and makes it 1:0.
35' Como have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Luca Caldirola (Monza) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Pepe Reina is prepared to thwart his effort.
32' Monza take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

31' That was close by Alessandro Bianco (Monza)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
29' Rough tackle by Pablo Mari (Monza). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
26' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Como, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Warren Bondo (Monza) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul. Como have a free kick.
24' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
20' Nico Paz (Como) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
20' The ball goes out for a corner. Como can continue in their attacking effort.

19' Patrick Cutrone (Como) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The referee signals a corner kick to Como.
19' Como take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
18' A clumsy foul by Luca Caldirola (Monza) and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle. Como earn a free kick.

16' Dany Mota (Monza) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
15' Alieu Fadera (Como) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Juan Luca Sacchi signals. A free kick is awarded to Monza.
13' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Pepe Reina has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
11' The percentage of ball possession is – 56:44.
8' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
8' Patrick Cutrone (Como) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. It will be a corner kick for Como.
7' Nico Paz (Como) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The ball is out of play. Como will have a throw-in.
6' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is penalised for a foul. Juan Luca Sacchi had a clear view and blows his whistle.

4' Alieu Fadera (Como) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
3' Como are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Como will take the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi will officiate today.
